_comment: Hook false-positive exceptions and audit-check exemptions. Each entry: {id, hook, pattern, reason, addedAt, addedBy, adr?}. Use hook='audit/<check>' for anti-pattern/cnt-health exemptions.

exceptions.reason: Chronicle dashboard is a local-only service. The localhost URLs are (a) the startup-message log telling the user where to navigate and (b) the API base URL in the embedded frontend template — both correct for a local dashboard.
Dashboard server: HTTP routing + embedded HTML template + chart bootstrap. 488 lines. Refactor candidate — extract HTML template to a separate file in a follow-up.
MCP server: tool registrations + handlers in one file. 509 lines. Cohesive surface — splitting would scatter the MCP tool definitions.
Coordination service: work-package decomposition + priority ranking + assignment. 771 lines. STRONG REFACTOR CANDIDATE — extract priority-ranking and assignment into separate modules in a follow-up.
Sync service: cloud<->local sync logic + conflict resolution. 523 lines. Refactor candidate — extract per-table sync handlers in a follow-up.
5 lines (limit 3). Includes ForgeCraft sentinel comment + description.
52 lines (limit 50). 2 lines over for chronicle's tier-memory model description, which is core to navigating the codebase.
Chronicle-specific standards: 180 lines. Tier-memory model + sync semantics + dashboard contracts are interlinked — splitting would scatter the knowledge.
